findings.comment: Gross floor area of 83,986 sf on a 94,192 sf site yields a Floor Area Ratio of 0.89:1, exceeding the maximum FAR of 0.5:1 allowed for MF-2 zoning per LDC § 25-2-492. No variance, bonus, or exemption documentation is provided. Reduce building mass or obtain an approved FAR variance prior to site plan approval.
